issue: Intermediate UGV junction treated as destination
finding: Intermediate waypoint advance threshold was 0.4 m while arrival threshold was 0.45 m; the carrier could complete at the junction 56.5 m before the destination.
correction: Advance the intermediate waypoint at 0.5 m and validate measured final destination distance.
regression: test_service_junction_is_waypoint_not_final_arrival; subsequent measured city destination error 0.449 m.

issue: Native city path parser loaded one waypoint
finding: GetNextElement sibling traversal requires its cloned SDF parent to remain alive; a temporary clone lost that parent.
correction: Retain cloned configuration while reading every waypoint and articulated visual part. Add local guidance with path-progress continuity.

issue: City contacts absent from recorded topic
finding: Gazebo Contact reads its transport override from sensor/contact/topic. The city generated only sensor/topic. Previous city contact counts do not establish zero contacts.
correction: Set both fields and subscribe to the actual contact topic; canonicalize collision pair order.
regression: Native sensor now records physical person_3/person_6 contact at 583.48 s instead of missing it; test_contact_topic_is_configured_for_native_contact_system verifies generated SDF.

finding: A person turning off the crossing reached a queued sidewalk pedestrian while body orientation expanded its occupied footprint.
correction: Increase cross-branch measured forward reservation to 2.2 m with anticipation out to 3.5 m. Collision geometry remains solid.

issue: Latch transition acknowledgement lost under fleet load
finding: A lower aircraft remained LATCHING after measured contact and disarm. The old trace cannot prove missing joint versus missing acknowledgement.
correction: Publish read-only measured DetachableJoint presence every 0.2 simulation seconds; built-in Gazebo actuator remains authoritative.
regression: Subsequent fleet run physically docked UAV02; single UAV04 confirmed contact/disarm/native latch.

issue: UAV04 landing target moved with delayed image
finding: Camera-relative tag displacement was being added to the current PX4 position even though the image was captured before that position changed.
correction: Use timestamp-synchronized PX4 camera-capture pose and attitude for a stable estimated-frame tag goal; retain assigned tag, freshness, velocity, contact, disarm and joint gates.
regression: gateway-validation-b4bd26d8-d79a-4edb-9947-7836d5a47562/landing-gate.json: PASS, 13.25 mm tag error, 0.14 s maximum descent image age; parent survey FAIL because no matching target was seen.

issue: Deliberate fault-injection request blocked the mission observer
finding: A synchronous 2 s transport request could leave Gazebo advancing while this validator was waiting, adding artificial delay before measured intrusion was handled.
correction: Bound the test request wait to 50 ms; actual actor pose intrusion still triggers the normal safety hold.
regression: city-1059191b-5e18-4a96-acac-d551c4bdad51 PASS: 0.1044 m stop displacement, zero measured UGV contacts; request acknowledgement was absent but physical pose intrusion was measured.

issue: Single person left the survey radius before aircraft launch
finding: The protected-lane UGV turn plus takeoff delayed survey until the walking actor was beyond the assigned radius. No visual target was seen; aircraft safely returned and docked.
correction: Named pedestrian scenarios use a deterministic initial approach placement. The actor still moves normally from startup; custom city placement is unchanged.
status: PASS: tracking-e731ce3e-723d-4a4c-83f3-12bdac8849e0, post-survey relaunch, explicit candidate confirmation, 75 fresh samples, 0.841 geometric visible coverage, physical docking.

issue: Car image track broken during flight reorientation
finding: An edge-of-image detection was lost while the aircraft turned and slowed to maintain the previous trailing offset. Seed-only compensation recovered some observations but did not meet continuity criteria.
correction: Reproject preceding tracker images using timestamped PX4 poses without changing the original appearance signature; retain launch heading for the nadir camera and reserve image coverage for class-wide body size and aircraft tilt.
regression: tracking-30c68526-6afb-472a-90b8-28b06d3b0f0b PASS: 50 fresh tracking samples, median distance 3.534 m, geometric visible coverage 0.685, zero resolved identity switches or false reacquisitions, native contact/disarm/latch at 157.93 s. Visual gaps remain.

issue: Lookalike encounter missed by one-sided site scan
finding: Two similar people passed 1.025 m apart near the survey centre, but the positive-only public-path scan saw only one after they separated. Following and recovery passed, but the intended ambiguity gate did not occur.
correction: Check the nearest public path first, scan both directions and revisit the centre; all goals use public map geometry and assigned site radius only.
status: PASS: tracking-368d5973-4ac3-407d-ae46-eb1545889191 exercised ambiguity and physical recovery; following continuity is a separate gate.

issue: Optical identity switched during a lookalike encounter
finding: The selected image tracker followed the other similarly dressed person while the second detector score was below catalogue confirmation. One ground-truth identity switch was measured.
correction: Challenge nearby separate same-colour image regions; use low-score rival detections for ambiguity, freeze the selected unresolved ID, and require explicit candidate confirmation.
regression: tracking-368d5973-4ac3-407d-ae46-eb1545889191 PASS: 1.004 m closest encounter, 3 confirmed visual IDs, 158 ambiguous samples, zero resolved identity switches/false reacquisitions/unconfirmed ID changes, physical docking at 135.94 s. This does not claim continuous tracking.

issue: Crowded single-bay city exposed physical actor contacts
finding: 16 native actor contacts, including a queued car/bus and two pedestrian pairs. UGV contact count remained zero. Earlier three-site acceptance did not expose this crowd concentration.
correction: Continuous comfort-gap braking plus a native 50 Hz oriented-rectangle motion forecast with physical clearance; retain solid occupancy and crossing permissions. Initial broad-corridor guards were interrupted after unnecessary bus braking beside parking.
status: Extended crowded-city repeat running; full-fleet acceptance remains pending.

issue: UAV02 landing oscillation under fleet load
finding: Assigned tag was visible in fresh images, but capture alignment labeled estimated poses with asynchronous callback arrival time. The DDS bridge also translated sensor timestamps to wall-clock time by default. The run stopped when the assigned tag remained outside view.
correction: Use actual PX4 timestamp_sample and closest sampled attitude; disable DDS wall-time timestamp translation in each owned SITL startup before starting its client. Preserve tag identity, freshness, contact, disarm and native joint gates.
status: Focused lower-UAV02 and loaded fleet repeats queued after the city gate.

cause: Disputed older IDs competed with a confirmed replacement for one current detection. An optical box displaced onto pavement could challenge the actual pedestrian as a separate colour region.
correction: All disputed hypotheses remain quarantined until operator confirmation. A clothing-colour challenge requires matching foreground pixels inside the current optical box; otherwise the lock is lost without claiming two people.

finding: 55 fresh samples and physical docking, but only 0.605 visible coverage; low-score shadow detections shared the pavement histogram and challenged real people.
correction: Person identity cues use saturated foreground clothing pixels. Too few pixels provide no identity cue. Cars keep their existing descriptor. Original follow thresholds remain unchanged.

issue: Tentative duplicate competition and abrupt follow correction
finding: 66 fresh samples, median follow distance 3.09 m and zero switches; coverage 0.699 remained below the unchanged 0.8 threshold.
correction: Continuing confirmed hypotheses take precedence over one-frame tentative duplicates. Same-frame separate lookalikes still challenge identity. Follow-goal changes are bounded by configured flight speed; weak person observations require foreground identity cues. High-score class detections can still confirm monochrome candidates from short continuous geometry.

issue: Loaded carousel budget expired while making physical progress
finding: All eight launched, all four lower aircraft physically docked, zero city contacts/swept excess. Return index still advanced from 0.536 m lateral displacement at 460.61 s to 0.240 m at 464.78 s when the old 80 s limit expired.
correction: Both measured gondola phases must continue advancing. A 20 s physical stall guard and 180 s maximum budget replace the fixed 80 s timeout. Indexed position/settling gates are unchanged.
focused_native_regression: loaded-carousel-96d6ad5a-2388-4e6f-b7b0-10fcdbc11de9 PASS with all eight attached; half indexes 20.34 s and 20.384 s

reason: UAV04 ALIGNING timeout at 420.55 simulation seconds; assigned tag remained visible; tag_error remained 0.10908 after approximately 344 seconds although image-relative offsets later fell below 0.07 m. Loaded carousel indexed successfully. Zero actor/UGV contacts.
correction: Resolve independent PX4 position and attitude samples at image use time rather than freezing attitude association at position callback. Added capture synchronization diagnostics. Strict limits unchanged.
status: Callback-order regression passes; focused UAV04 and fleet physical verification pending.

reason: UAV02 TAG_ACQUIRE timeout; assigned tag visible but capture timestamp fell outside retained estimator histories; descent correctly refused.
correction: Bound display pose/joint subscriber rates to 30 Hz, subscribe native Gazebo clock at 20 Hz and never rewind it from delayed stats; increase separate estimator histories to 2000 positions/5000 attitudes; defer quaternion conversion to image use and convert pixels outside shared transport lock. Raw sample times and freshness thresholds unchanged.
verification: Focused physical UAV02 gate PASS at artifacts/gateway-validation-5cdb2500-6647-4c48-8131-26abe00026e2; final tag error 17.28 mm; eight-aircraft gate underway.

scope: Eight-aircraft six-wheel physical launch/recovery, loaded carousel, crowded-city contacts and measured footprint sweep.
corrections_verified: PX4 independent capture alignment; bounded display callbacks/native clock/history; progress-monitored carousel; asynchronous changed-phase camera capture and bounded compact authority logs. Prior failed reports remain failed.
